purpose: Fixed and uniformly translating prescribed cloth coupled to real MPM; no free-cloth dynamics.

budgets.per_message: scene.transport.timeouts of the configuration: hello 120, register 120, open 30, peer 30, impulse 30, send 30, stop 5 s; service idle watchdog 300 s (bounds MPM's time per window)
budgets.memory_monitor: measured or stop: a sample that fails or counts no running process ends the step (exit 5); pre-flight before any heavy step: a probe and its child holding 32 + 128 MiB must both be counted (>= 2 processes, >= 128 MiB), else exit 4; Windows process walk: only FALSE from Process32NextW with ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES ends it, any other failure or a walk without the running step process is a monitor failure

cases.name: n24_fixed_30
cases.what: fixed sheet, sand resting on it (U2 E1 geometry)

cases.name: n24_drop_150
cases.what: fixed sheet, block 5 cm above it: separation then contact (U2 E2)

cases.name: n24_down_150
cases.what: sheet moving down at 0.3 m/s under resting sand: contact, separation, contact again (U2 E3)

cases.name: n24_translate_300
cases.what: sheet translating at (0.2, 0, 0) m/s, mu 0.8, drags the layer (U2 E4)

cases.name: n64_fixed_30
cases.what: fixed sheet, P1 F3 block resting on it

cases.name: n64_translate_300
cases.what: sheet translating at (0.2, 0, 0) m/s, mu 0.8, under the P1 F3 block

lock: Exact source and package digest inventory, checked before every step; this is a new candidate, not the original baseline.

common_gates.run_status: scene exit 0, status ok, every requested window acknowledged
common_gates.xpbd_clean_stop: the service answered STOP with BYE, exit code 0, not terminated, no late frames
common_gates.reconcile: coupling.driver.reconcile row by row: consistent, no extra XPBD window, log_condition final, XPBD committed = windows, final reason STOP
common_gates.archive: coupling.archive.verify: complete, every window acknowledged, the code digest matches the package sources, the run anchor (config.json, run_info.json) matches
common_gates.replay_transport: path A (the archive's sealed inputs through the transport into a fresh service process): registration digest, every offer digest and every receipt digest equal to the run's; first snapshot equal to snapshot0; clean stop
common_gates.replay_offline: path B (the same inputs consumed by the same XPBD adapter in one process): receipt digests equal to the run's, canonical receipt bytes equal to path A's, all 12 fields of every committed snapshot equal to path A's
common_gates.provenance: all five pinned XPBD files at their SHA-256 on disk (inputs.json) and every pinned file the service imported (HELLO; the four core files among them), no taichi / mpm in the service, no fault injection, no bytecode, Python and NumPy of the service = the MPM registration's, service pid != MPM pid; source kind real_backend; stream u4-*; registration digest equal in the endpoint, BOUND and both replays
common_gates.u13_boundary: every receipt (path B; byte-equal to the run's), each key present: kinematic true, free_dof_count 0, motion fixed / uniform_constant_translation as the case, load_received true, load_applied_to_geometry false, support_balance null, drive_work null, reaction_measurement not_measured; start_version and committed_version keep the initial topology_version
common_gates.u13_motion: the run's transform matches the fixed example R/c/C, status fixed-transform-v1, and contains no personal signoff; every snapshot (path B, the opening one and each committed one): epoch constant, topology_version = the initial one of the snapshot spec, step_index = k, velocity = R^T v_world on every vertex exactly, |X_k - X_0 - k h v| <= 1e-12 m, |time_k - k h| <= 1e-12 s, dt = h
common_gates.impulse_frame: archive coordinate frame world (XPBD native), units SI; per window the world and native batch sums map by R (world x = native x, world y = native z, world z = -native y) and equal the archive's batch sums, each component to 1e-12 of the window's impulse magnitude |sum G| (the sums differ only in reduction order)
common_gates.mpm_balance: frame balance bal_rel max <= 1e-10 (stop rule S7)

tests_gate: exit 0, junit readable, no failure / error / skip, exactly tests_expected tests; otherwise stop before the joint cases (exit 3), keeping logs/tests.log, tests/junit.xml and tests/tmp/ (failed tests' temporary directories); a test running longer than 240 s writes the stacks of all threads into logs/tests.log (pytest faulthandler_timeout, diagnosis only)
